title: Letter River: a guided Hebrew-learning prototype
summary: An independent Hebrew-learning prototype exploring a guided path from letter recognition to vocabulary and reading. The case study shows the screens, connected practice flow, and the decisions behind them.
highlights: A path from letter recognition through vocabulary to reading, built as one flow
Desktop and mobile screens from the working prototype
What the prototype does not yet prove, and the next step to test it
